title: 反應式離子蝕刻
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究電漿與表面、輪廓與選擇性、端點與均勻性、損傷與轉移；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: plasma and surface, profile and selectivity, endpoint and uniformity, damage and transfer. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

Finally check your inference against this principle: Particle populations have different energies and directionality.
